file_roles.evidence: Adds tableName and dataType fields and constructor parameters; data carrier change forced by the conversion fix in IgniteH2Indexing.
Inline type conversion replaced by call to new H2Utils.convert; code moved.
New static convert() contains the conversion code moved from DmlStatementsProcessor.
calculateQueryPartitions used the raw params[paramIdx] for affinity().partition; new bindPartitionInfoParameter converts the parameter with H2Utils.convert to the column type first.
size = (short)s.length | 0x8000 changed to handle s == null from trimUTF8, fixing an NPE for multibyte strings in index inlining.
Passes tbl.getName() and column type into CacheQueryPartitionInfo; plumbing for the conversion fix.

rationale: Two commits sit under one issue. One fixes an NPE for a unicode value in an inlined index, the other fixes partition calculation when the parameter type differs. The report only describes unicode in an index, so only the first clearly matches. I marked both as causal for the defect each corrects.
notes: Report text matches the inline NPE commit; link to the partition commit is not shown by the report. A reproducer or the JIRA discussion would settle it.
